INTERGOVERNMENTAL AFFAIRS
  COMMITTEE AGENDA
  TUESDAY, FEBRUARY 10, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  THE BEACH CONFERENCE ROOM, 2ND FLOOR, 1:00 PM

Roberto Uranga, Chair
Megan Kerr, Vice Chair
Kristina Duggan, Member

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT ONLINE PUBLIC COMMENTS
  AND EMAIL COMMENTS TO CITYCLERK@LONGBEACH.GOV

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-54318  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Intergovernmental Affairs
  Committee meeting of Thursday, August 21, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-54319  Recommendation to receive and file a staff presentation on the Year in Review
  document.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-54320  Recommendation to receive and file a staff presentation on the Los Angeles

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

Opportunity to address the Intergovernmental Affairs Committee on non-agenda items. Each
speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ADJOURNMENT

prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101
or cityclerk@longbeach.gov.
